class.name: NNHTNPlanStep
class.brief_description: One occurrence of a primitive task in an HTN plan.
class.description: Planning creates one step each time it uses an [NNHTNTask], so a template used twice produces two steps with their own [member occurrence_id], [member args], [member effects] and [member runtime]. Steps are passed to [method NNHTNTask.on_execute] and [method NNHTNTask.on_cancel] and are returned by [method NNHTNRoot.get_plan]. A branch of an [NNHTNParallelTask] is a step like any other, with the [code]parallel_*[/code] properties describing its group. All properties are read-only. [member args] and [member effects] are read-only dictionaries; [member runtime] is the one place meant for writing.

method.name: get_observed_effect_keys
method.description: Returns the keys of [member effects] that are not written to the board on success, because of the [member NNHTNTask.runtime_effect_commit_mode] captured when the occurrence was planned. Sensors are expected to write them.

method.name: get_provenance
method.description: Returns the method decompositions that produced this step, from the domain's method inward, as dictionaries with the keys [code]frame_id[/code] (unique among the plans of one root, so a step kept from an earlier plan never shares a frame with an unrelated new one), [code]compound[/code] and [code]method[/code] (the nodes, or [code]null[/code] once freed), [code]args[/code] (the method's arguments), [code]method_path[/code], [code]child_index[/code] (the position, among the method's enabled children, of the child this step descends from) and [code]span_start[/code] and [code]span_end[/code] (the inclusive plan indices of every step that decomposition produced). Plan indices count the steps that already succeeded, see [method NNHTNRoot.get_completed_steps].

method.name: has_valid_references
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [member task] still exists, is enabled and is not queued for deletion, and every [Object] in [member args], at any depth, is still alive and, if it is a [Node], not queued for deletion. The root checks this before every tick of a step.

members.member: The occurrence's arguments, fixed when it was planned. Read-only.
The decomposition path from the domain to the task, as slash-separated node names, including the names of any [NNHTNSubtaskCall] nodes followed.

The estimated cost captured when the occurrence was planned (see [member NNHTNTask.estimated_cost]). Never recomputed. Always [code]0.0[/code] unless the plan was found under [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.LOWEST_COST].

The [member NNHTNParallelTask.effects] of a serialized group, carried by its last branch and written in the same batch as this step's own effects, after them, whatever its [member NNHTNTask.runtime_effect_commit_mode]. Empty for every other step. Read-only.

The effects captured when the occurrence was planned. Planning always predicts all of them. When the occurrence succeeds, the keys its captured [member NNHTNTask.runtime_effect_commit_mode] allows are written to the board; see [method get_observed_effect_keys] for the rest. Never recomputed. Read-only.

Why the occurrence failed, or empty. One of [code]"invalidated"[/code] (it failed the checks made before each tick), [code]"execution_failed"[/code] ([method NNHTNTask.on_execute] returned [constant NNHTNTask.FAILURE] or an invalid value), [code]"verification_failed"[/code], [code]"verification_timeout"[/code], [code]"verification_unsafe"[/code] ([method NNHTNTask.on_can_continue_verification] returned [code]false[/code]) or [code]"effect_commit_failed"[/code].
A positive identifier unique to this occurrence for the lifetime of the program.
The number of branches in this step's group, or [code]0[/code] when it does not come from an [NNHTNParallelTask].
This step's position among its group's enabled branches, from [code]0[/code], or [code]-1[/code] when it does not come from an [NNHTNParallelTask].
The group this step was planned from, concurrent or serialized, or [code]null[/code] when it does not come from an [NNHTNParallelTask] or the group was freed.
The arguments the group was planned with, which its conditions are checked with before every tick of a concurrent group. Read-only.

The [member NNHTNParallelTask.effects] captured when a concurrent group was planned, written with the branches' effects when the whole group succeeds. Empty for a serialized group, see [member deferred_group_effects]. Read-only.

A positive identifier shared by every branch of one planned concurrent group, so a template used in two groups gives two ids. [code]0[/code] for every other step, including the branches of a serialized group.
Mutable data for this occurrence alone, such as timers and progress. It starts empty. Write to the returned dictionary.
Where the occurrence is in its life cycle.
The template this occurrence instantiates, or [code]null[/code] once it is freed.

The tick delta accumulated while this occurrence verified, including the tick in which [method NNHTNTask.on_execute] returned [constant NNHTNTask.SUCCESS]. Compared with [member NNHTNTask.verification_timeout].

constants.constant: [method NNHTNTask.on_execute] returned [constant NNHTNTask.SUCCESS] and the occurrence waits for verification (see [member NNHTNTask.verification_mode]). It still counts as started, so replacing it cancels it.

A branch of a concurrent [NNHTNParallelTask] that finished successfully and waits for its siblings. Its effects are not yet written. It is never ticked or cancelled again, and stays staged if the group fails.
Finished successfully, with its effects committed. A group's branches succeed together when the group commits.
Abandoned while running or verifying because the plan was replaced or abandoned, for example by disabling the root.
